proposed_response_blind_requirements: Freeze immutable source bytes, checksum and independent physical CSV header before opening any focal biological data rows.
Recover patch register, coordinate reference, unique UID mapping and all census visit opportunities without using occupancy outcomes.
Determine whether repeated within-year visits separate survey effort from imperfect detection, and document missing visits vs confirmed nondetection.
Freeze baseline model with asymmetric distance/wind connectivity, moss area, phorophyte type, temporal/climate effects and detection.
Only after these gates freeze time split, event eligibility, source/recipient roles, source-loss definition, added EOG terms and terminal stop rules.
When outcomes open, score genuinely held-out colonization/recolonization rather than simulated graph reachability as biological success.
primary_novelty_gate: Must beat a strong graph/dynamic-occupancy comparator already represented by the 2020 source paper; a simple connectivity effect is prior art.
caution: This is not a randomized source-loss intervention; apparent source loss can reflect nondetection or demographic/environmental differences. Do not call it causal insurance.
